focus: 把消波構件的材料品質、形狀與安放接觸連成可追溯驗證~Connect concrete armour material quality, geometry and placed contacts through traceable verification

units.anchor: 質量與排水體積~Mass and displaced volume
units.title: 質量與排水體積~Mass and displaced volume
units.mechanism: 混凝土消波構件的質量影響水下有效重量，但水工功能還取決於形狀、接觸和孔隙。從密度換算體積只是一致性檢查，不能由相同噸數推定不同專利形狀的穩定性相同，也不能取代裂縫和缺角檢查。 假設乾質量3000kg、材料密度2400kg/m³，實體V=M/ρ=1.25m³；海水1025kg/m³時有效重為16.86kN，非產品規格。 質量驗證也應保留水下有效重的定義，浸水可達孔隙會影響排水體積。~Concrete-unit mass influences submerged weight, while hydraulic behavior also depends on shape, contacts and voids. Density-to-volume conversion is a consistency check, not evidence that different proprietary shapes with equal tonnage have equal stability or freedom from cracking and missing corners. Assume mass3000kg and density2400kg/m³: solid V=1.25m³. In seawater1025kg/m³ effective weight is16.86kN; these are not product specifications. Mass checks must retain the submerged-weight definition because water-accessible voids can affect the displaced volume used for buoyancy calculation.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾質量3000kg、材料密度2400kg/m³，實體V=M/ρ=1.25m³；海水1025kg/m³時有效重為16.86kN，非產品規格。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass3000kg and density2400kg/m³: solid V=1.25m³. In seawater1025kg/m³ effective weight is16.86kN; these are not product specifications.
units.verify: 將每一代表構件的秤重、體積和含水狀態對照，查看模具尺寸及外觀紀錄是否相符。另以設計採用的形狀分類檢查接觸，避免僅用質量取代完整幾何驗證。另列缺角位置相對主要接觸臂的位置。~Compare representative unit weight, volume and moisture state with mould and visual records. Independently check contact behavior for the specified shape family rather than substituting mass measurement for complete geometric verification. Locate missing corners relative to the primary contact arms.
units.failure: 缺角可能只減少少量質量卻破壞主要接觸臂，密度平均值因此仍合格。若只按噸數出廠，安放後互鎖下降可能直到暴風才被發現，修復亦更困難。~A missing corner may remove little mass but destroy an important contact arm while average density still passes. Mass-only release can conceal reduced interlock until a storm reveals a defect that is then harder to repair.
units.misconception: 任何形狀的消波塊只要質量相同就有相同水工穩定性。~Concrete armour units of any shape have identical hydraulic stability when mass matches.
units.practice: 將每一代表構件的秤重、體積和含水狀態對照，查看模具尺寸及外觀紀錄是否相符。另以設計採用的形狀分類檢查接觸，避免僅用質量取代完整幾何驗證。~Compare representative unit weight, volume and moisture state with mould and visual records. Independently check contact behavior for the specified shape family rather than substituting mass measurement for complete geometric verification.

units.anchor: 有效用水與配比~Effective water accounting
units.title: 有效用水與配比~Effective water accounting
units.mechanism: 配比中的有效用水量要考慮骨材吸水與表面水，不是水表讀值單獨決定。水膠比與工作性、強度和耐久性相關，但本課示意只追蹤收支，不能由一個比值保證大型異形構件內部密實。 假設膠材340kg、加入水170kg，其中8kg被乾骨材吸收且無表面水，有效水膠比(170−8)/340=0.4765；非配方建議。 膠材不一定只有水泥，計算分母需要遵循核准配比中對膠材的明確定義。~Effective mix water depends on aggregate absorption and surface moisture, not just the metered addition. Water-to-binder ratio relates to workability, strength and durability, but this illustration tracks accounting only; one ratio cannot guarantee consolidation inside a large complex unit. Assume binder340kg and water170kg, with8kg absorbed by dry aggregate and no surface water. Effective ratio=(170−8)/340=0.4765, not a mix recommendation. Binder need not consist only of cement; the calculation denominator must follow the explicit binder definition in the approved mixture.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設膠材340kg、加入水170kg，其中8kg被乾骨材吸收且無表面水，有效水膠比(170−8)/340=0.4765；非配方建議。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume binder340kg and water170kg, with8kg absorbed by dry aggregate and no surface water. Effective ratio=(170−8)/340=0.4765, not a mix recommendation.
units.verify: 分別記錄骨材含水、吸水試驗和加水量，說明哪些水被計入有效水量。核對工作性與代表試體，不以現場臨時加水改善外觀而略過核准配比和追溯紀錄。確認加水與骨材試驗的時間相符。~Record aggregate moisture, absorption testing and added water separately, identifying effective-water assumptions. Check workability and representative specimens without treating unrecorded field water addition as an acceptable substitute for the approved mixture. Confirm matching times for water addition and aggregate testing.
units.failure: 骨材含水變化未修正會讓相同水表數字對應不同水膠比，局部泌水或離析也可能出現。只看試體平均強度，仍可能漏掉構件細長部位的弱區。~Uncorrected aggregate moisture gives different effective ratios at identical meter readings and can produce bleeding or segregation. An acceptable average specimen strength may still conceal weak material in slender portions of the actual unit.
units.misconception: 每批水表加入相同水量就代表有效水膠比保持不變。~Identical metered water addition guarantees an unchanged effective water-to-binder ratio.
units.practice: 分別記錄骨材含水、吸水試驗和加水量，說明哪些水被計入有效水量。核對工作性與代表試體，不以現場臨時加水改善外觀而略過核准配比和追溯紀錄。~Record aggregate moisture, absorption testing and added water separately, identifying effective-water assumptions. Check workability and representative specimens without treating unrecorded field water addition as an acceptable substitute for the approved mixture.

units.anchor: 自由熱變形尺度~Free thermal movement scale
units.title: 自由熱變形尺度~Free thermal movement scale
units.mechanism: 大型混凝土構件的表面與內部溫度歷程不同，均勻自由伸縮只能提供基礎量級。若存在溫度梯度或模具約束，就會額外產生應力；把自由變形算式誤當成裂縫預測會遺漏養護和形狀的作用。 假設α=10⁻⁵/K、均勻溫差25K、長L=2m，自由變形ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm；不含約束。 膨脹係數也可能因骨材而異，模型固定係數不等於所有混凝土都具有相同熱行為。~The surface and core of a large unit follow different temperature histories. Uniform free expansion supplies a basic scale only; gradients or mould restraint generate additional stress. Treating free movement as a crack prediction omits curing conditions and geometric effects. Assumeα=10⁻⁵/K, uniform change25K and length2m. Free movement ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm, excluding restraint. Thermal expansion depends on aggregate as well, so a fixed coefficient in the example does not imply identical behavior for every concrete.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設α=10⁻⁵/K、均勻溫差25K、長L=2m，自由變形ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm；不含約束。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assumeα=10⁻⁵/K, uniform change25K and length2m. Free movement ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm, excluding restraint.
units.verify: 在厚部與細臂配置相對應的溫度紀錄，區分均勻降溫與內外梯度。將實測變形和模具接觸狀態一起比較，確認採用自由膨脹假設的區段是否真的未受拘束。用另一組長度或溫差檢查線性換算。~Compare temperature histories in thick portions and slender arms, separating uniform cooling from gradients. Relate measured movement to mould contact and verify that portions modeled as freely expanding actually lack significant restraint. Check the linear conversion using another length or temperature interval.
units.failure: 表面已降溫而核心仍熱時，單一平均溫度會掩蓋內外應變差；局部細臂可能先裂。即使外部總長變化很小，也不能據此排除內部自平衡熱應力。~A cooled surface with a warm core creates strain differences hidden by average temperature, potentially cracking slender arms first. Small overall length change does not exclude internal self-equilibrating thermal stress within the unit.
units.misconception: 整體長度變化很小就表示混凝土內部沒有熱應力。~Small overall length change proves there is no internal thermal stress.
units.practice: 在厚部與細臂配置相對應的溫度紀錄，區分均勻降溫與內外梯度。將實測變形和模具接觸狀態一起比較，確認採用自由膨脹假設的區段是否真的未受拘束。~Compare temperature histories in thick portions and slender arms, separating uniform cooling from gradients. Relate measured movement to mould contact and verify that portions modeled as freely expanding actually lack significant restraint.

units.anchor: 約束冷卻與裂縫~Restrained cooling and cracking
units.title: 約束冷卻與裂縫~Restrained cooling and cracking
units.mechanism: 約束會把熱收縮轉換成拉應力，但混凝土齡期、徐變、開裂和約束鬆弛都使反應隨時間變化。完全約束線彈性式只用來比較量級，不能把固定彈性模數一路套到所有養護階段或實際裂縫寬度。 假設E=25GPa、α=10⁻⁵/K、完全約束冷卻25K，σ=EαΔT=6.25MPa拉應力；實際開裂與徐變需另算。 抗拉能力也隨齡期改變，應力和抗力需在相同時間比較才有物理意義。~Restraint converts thermal contraction into tension, but concrete age, creep, cracking and restraint relaxation change response over time. A fully restrained elastic estimate compares scales only; fixed modulus cannot represent every curing stage or directly predict the resulting crack width. Assume E=25GPa,α=10⁻⁵/K and fully restrained cooling25K. Elastic tensionσ=EαΔT=6.25MPa; cracking and creep require separate treatment. Tensile resistance changes with age too; comparing stress and resistance at the same time is necessary for a physically meaningful interpretation.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設E=25GPa、α=10⁻⁵/K、完全約束冷卻25K，σ=EαΔT=6.25MPa拉應力；實際開裂與徐變需另算。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume E=25GPa,α=10⁻⁵/K and fully restrained cooling25K. Elastic tensionσ=EαΔT=6.25MPa; cracking and creep require separate treatment.
units.verify: 記錄溫度、齡期及模具或基座約束，檢查模型採用的彈性模數與實際時間是否一致。用裂縫位置和發展時序比較可能機制，不以一個理想應力直接宣告構件可用。對照開裂時間與材料齡期的強度資料。~Record temperature, age and mould or base restraint and match modulus to the relevant time. Compare crack locations and chronology with competing mechanisms rather than declaring a unit acceptable from one ideal elastic stress. Compare cracking time with age-matched material strength evidence.
units.failure: 以成熟混凝土模數套用早齡期可能高估或錯排應力時序，忽略徐變又改變鬆弛預測；反之僅因理論值過高而任意刪除約束，也會低估真實裂縫風險。~Using mature modulus at early age can misstate stress magnitude and timing, while omitted creep changes relaxation. Arbitrarily removing restraint merely because the theoretical stress seems high instead understates genuine cracking potential.
units.misconception: 完全約束彈性熱應力就是實際混凝土最後一定保留的應力。~Fully restrained elastic thermal stress is the stress the concrete must retain permanently.
units.practice: 記錄溫度、齡期及模具或基座約束，檢查模型採用的彈性模數與實際時間是否一致。用裂縫位置和發展時序比較可能機制，不以一個理想應力直接宣告構件可用。~Record temperature, age and mould or base restraint and match modulus to the relevant time. Compare crack locations and chronology with competing mechanisms rather than declaring a unit acceptable from one ideal elastic stress.

units.anchor: 試體強度與構件~Specimen strength versus unit behavior
units.title: 試體強度與構件~Specimen strength versus unit behavior
units.mechanism: 抗壓試體提供特定製作養護和載入條件下的材料證據，異形消波構件卻可能受彎曲、局部接觸和吊運拉力控制。試體與構件的溫度歷程、密實度和尺度不同，因此名義抗壓值不能代表全部構造能力。 假設立方試體邊長0.15m、破壞荷重900kN，f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa；不是直接設計強度。 試體平均值與特徵值的統計意義不同，樣本數及離散程度需另外明列。~Compression specimens provide evidence under specified preparation, curing and loading, while armour units can be governed by bending, local contacts and lifting tension. Their temperature histories, consolidation and size differ, so nominal compressive strength cannot describe every structural capacity of the full unit. Assume a0.15m cube and failure load900kN. f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa is specimen strength, not directly a design strength. A specimen mean and a characteristic value have different statistical meanings, requiring separate statements of sample size and observed variability.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設立方試體邊長0.15m、破壞荷重900kN，f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa；不是直接設計強度。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a0.15m cube and failure load900kN. f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa is specimen strength, not directly a design strength.
units.verify: 核對試體尺寸、端面、載入方法與養護紀錄，將取樣批次連回實際構件。另檢查細臂、轉角與吊點的受力模式，避免讓抗壓試驗代替必要的材料或構造驗證。再檢查試體與構件的養護溫度差異。~Check specimen dimensions, ends, loading method and curing, linking each sample to its production batch. Separately review slender arms, corners and lifting points so compression testing does not replace other necessary material or structural verification. Check curing-temperature differences between specimens and full units.
units.failure: 試體養護較好時可能高估構件內部品質，局部蜂窩又未必出現在取樣中；平均抗壓值達標仍可能伴隨吊運破裂或安放後接觸臂損傷。~Better specimen curing can overstate actual unit quality, and sampling may miss local honeycombing. A passing mean compressive strength can coexist with lifting fractures or damaged contact arms after placement at the site.
units.misconception: 抗壓試體合格即可證明消波構件吊點和細臂承載都合格。~Passing compression specimens also proves adequate lifting points and slender arms.
units.practice: 核對試體尺寸、端面、載入方法與養護紀錄，將取樣批次連回實際構件。另檢查細臂、轉角與吊點的受力模式，避免讓抗壓試驗代替必要的材料或構造驗證。~Check specimen dimensions, ends, loading method and curing, linking each sample to its production batch. Separately review slender arms, corners and lifting points so compression testing does not replace other necessary material or structural verification.

units.anchor: 吊運力向分解~Resolving handling forces
units.title: 吊運力向分解~Resolving handling forces
units.mechanism: 消波構件的吊點與重心受複雜形狀影響，索力會因夾角增加而上升。理想兩索靜力分析需同時滿足對稱與共同受力，不能取代專用吊具、動載和早齡期材料能力的核准檢查。 假設質量3000kg、兩索各與垂直45°且靜態對稱，T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN；未含動載或偏心。 吊點局部作用還取決於嵌件與混凝土的傳力，單一索力不能證明錨定合格。~Complex geometry affects lifting points and gravity center, and sling force rises with inclination. An ideal two-sling static model requires symmetry and simultaneous engagement; it does not replace approved checks of lifting equipment, dynamics and early-age material capacity. Assume mass3000kg and two symmetric static slings45° from vertical. T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN, excluding dynamics and eccentricity. Local attachment behavior depends on force transfer through inserts and concrete; one sling-force result cannot establish adequate anchorage performance.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設質量3000kg、兩索各與垂直45°且靜態對稱，T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN；未含動載或偏心。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass3000kg and two symmetric static slings45° from vertical. T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN, excluding dynamics and eccentricity.
units.verify: 用實際吊點與重心位置畫自由體圖，核對角度基準、各索受力及局部構件應力。保留核准吊裝方案與材料齡期紀錄，確保教學計算沒有被當作設備操作指令。將吊點能力的證據與索力分開歸檔。~Draw the actual lifting points and gravity center, checking angle convention, sling forces and local unit stresses. Retain the approved lifting plan and material-age evidence so the teaching calculation is not used as equipment instructions. File attachment-capacity evidence separately from calculated sling forces.
units.failure: 一索先張緊時對稱分配不成立，構件姿態轉動又會改變吊點力向；早期細臂裂縫可能在後續安放才顯現，僅查總吊重不能追出受損原因。~Symmetric sharing fails when one sling engages first, while rotation changes attachment force directions. Early cracking in slender arms may appear only after placement, and total lifted weight alone cannot explain the damage history.
units.misconception: 對稱吊索的理想靜力數值已包含海上起伏造成的動載。~Ideal symmetric sling forces already include dynamic loading from offshore motion.
units.practice: 用實際吊點與重心位置畫自由體圖，核對角度基準、各索受力及局部構件應力。保留核准吊裝方案與材料齡期紀錄，確保教學計算沒有被當作設備操作指令。~Draw the actual lifting points and gravity center, checking angle convention, sling forces and local unit stresses. Retain the approved lifting plan and material-age evidence so the teaching calculation is not used as equipment instructions.

units.anchor: 安放密度與孔隙~Placement density and voids
units.title: 安放密度與孔隙~Placement density and voids
units.mechanism: 安放密度連結構件數量與覆蓋面積，但互鎖還取決於姿態、層數和接觸位置。每平方米的件數不能直接換成孔隙率，也不能只增加件數就期待水工功能改善，過密可能改變透流與局部架空。 假設同一層200件覆蓋1000m²，安放密度N/A=0.20件/m²；未提供體積與層厚，不能推出孔隙率。 實際斜面和水平面積的選擇會改變名義件數密度，跨專案比較要先統一定義。~Placement density relates unit count to area, but interlocking also depends on orientation, layers and contacts. Units per square metre cannot be directly converted into porosity, and adding more units need not improve performance because overly dense placement can alter flow and create unsupported contacts. Assume200 units cover1000m² in one layer. Placement density is0.20units/m²; without volume and thickness it does not determine porosity. Choosing actual slope area versus horizontal projection changes nominal placement density, so comparisons across projects require a consistent denominator first.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同一層200件覆蓋1000m²，安放密度N/A=0.20件/m²；未提供體積與層厚，不能推出孔隙率。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume200 units cover1000m² in one layer. Placement density is0.20units/m²; without volume and thickness it does not determine porosity.
units.verify: 明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。與該構件型式核准的安放規則對照，保留局部空缺而不是用全堤平均密度掩蓋。分別檢查坡腳和坡頂的局部覆蓋。~State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone. Compare the approved rules for that unit type, preserving local gaps rather than hiding them in a whole-structure mean. Check local coverage at toe and crest separately.
units.failure: 高處多放構件可以使平均件數達標，坡腳空缺卻仍存在；架空構件在波浪下可能重新轉動。只驗收總數量，不能確認荷載和互鎖已沿斷面連續傳遞。~Extra units higher up can satisfy average count while toe gaps remain, and bridged units may rotate under waves. Total quantity alone does not establish continuous contact, load transfer or interlocking along the section.
units.misconception: 總安放件數達標就能證明每一個區域都有足夠互鎖。~Meeting the total unit count proves adequate interlocking in every local area.
units.practice: 明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。與該構件型式核准的安放規則對照，保留局部空缺而不是用全堤平均密度掩蓋。~State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone. Compare the approved rules for that unit type, preserving local gaps rather than hiding them in a whole-structure mean.

units.anchor: 三維位置與姿態~Three-dimensional placement geometry
units.title: 三維位置與姿態~Three-dimensional placement geometry
units.mechanism: 水下安放需把位置誤差與姿態誤差分開，三維坐標偏差小不代表接觸臂方向正確。測量基準、船體姿態和吊具桿臂都會影響重建位置，圖上的點位必須能追溯到構件的特定參考點。 假設參考點偏差Δx=0.10m、Δy=0.20m、Δz=0.05m，距離e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m；不是姿態誤差。 位置距離是三維向量的長度，不會保留偏移方向，方向仍需另行記錄。~Underwater placement separates position error from orientation error; small coordinate deviation does not establish correct contact-arm direction. Survey datum, vessel attitude and rig lever arms affect reconstruction, so each plotted position must refer to a defined point on the actual unit. Assume reference-point offsets0.10m,0.20m and0.05m. Distance e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m does not describe orientation error. Position distance is the magnitude of a three-dimensional vector and does not preserve direction, which must therefore remain separately recorded.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設參考點偏差Δx=0.10m、Δy=0.20m、Δz=0.05m，距離e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m；不是姿態誤差。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume reference-point offsets0.10m,0.20m and0.05m. Distance e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m does not describe orientation error.
units.verify: 用獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換，將吊具參考點換算到構件指定點，另記姿態與接觸。比較安放前後的水下影像或測量資料，保留量測不確定度與盲區。同時保存三個方向的原始偏差值。~Check coordinate transformations against independent control, transfer the rig reference to the specified unit point and record orientation and contact separately. Compare underwater observations before and after placement, retaining uncertainty and blind zones. Preserve the original offsets in all three directions.
units.failure: 參考點選錯可能讓所有坐標一致偏移，姿態未記錄則無法辨識接觸臂翻轉。點位殘差小仍可能對應水工模型從未驗證過的安放方式，影響後續穩定判讀。~An incorrect reference point shifts every coordinate consistently, while missing orientation hides reversed contact arms. Small position residuals can therefore coexist with an arrangement never validated in the hydraulic model used for stability assessment.
units.misconception: 構件參考點位置正確就能證明其朝向與接觸也正確。~Correct reference-point coordinates prove correct orientation and contacts.
units.practice: 用獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換，將吊具參考點換算到構件指定點，另記姿態與接觸。比較安放前後的水下影像或測量資料，保留量測不確定度與盲區。~Check coordinate transformations against independent control, transfer the rig reference to the specified unit point and record orientation and contact separately. Compare underwater observations before and after placement, retaining uncertainty and blind zones.

units.anchor: 模型質量縮尺~Model mass scaling
units.title: 模型質量縮尺~Model mass scaling
units.mechanism: 幾何縮尺構件的體積按長度三次方變化，相同材料密度才可直接使用相同質量比。實體試驗還需維持相對密度、表面粗糙和接觸方式，不能只做外形相似卻讓有效重量與摩擦特性失去對應。 假設原型質量3000kg、長度比20且材料密度相同，模型質量3000/20³=0.375kg；同時需檢查水下相對密度。 模型接觸面若相對粗糙過大，摩擦行為可能與原型不同，即使質量縮尺正確。~Geometrically scaled units change volume with the cube of length, and equal material density permits the same mass ratio. Physical tests also require appropriate relative density, roughness and contacts; matching the silhouette alone does not preserve submerged weight or interface behavior. Assume prototype mass3000kg, length ratio20 and equal material density. Model mass=3000/20³=0.375kg, with submerged relative density checked separately. Excessive relative roughness at model contacts can alter friction even when the mass scaling is correct for the chosen geometry.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型質量3000kg、長度比20且材料密度相同，模型質量3000/20³=0.375kg；同時需檢查水下相對密度。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype mass3000kg, length ratio20 and equal material density. Model mass=3000/20³=0.375kg, with submerged relative density checked separately.
units.verify: 同時量模型尺寸、質量及使用水體密度，檢查相對密度和有效重量是否符合試驗設計。另以安放照片比對接觸點，說明粗糙尺度不能完全相似的限制。檢查模型接觸面的粗糙與摩擦假設。~Measure model dimensions, mass and water density together, verifying relative density and submerged weight against the test design. Compare contact points through placement images and state limitations where surface roughness cannot be fully scaled. Check assumptions for model contact roughness and friction.
units.failure: 用低密度列印件卻只按長度縮小，模型可能比原型容易移動；額外加重若集中在一點又會改變重心。質量吻合仍不足以證明動態轉動完全相似。~Low-density printed units scaled only by length can move more readily than the prototype. Concentrated added weight changes gravity center, so even a matching total mass does not establish dynamically similar rotation of the unit.
units.misconception: 外形縮小二十倍時質量也只要縮小二十倍即可。~Scaling the shape down by twenty requires mass to decrease only twentyfold.
units.practice: 同時量模型尺寸、質量及使用水體密度，檢查相對密度和有效重量是否符合試驗設計。另以安放照片比對接觸點，說明粗糙尺度不能完全相似的限制。~Measure model dimensions, mass and water density together, verifying relative density and submerged weight against the test design. Compare contact points through placement images and state limitations where surface roughness cannot be fully scaled.

units.anchor: 磨耗試驗與壽命~Abrasion testing and service life
units.title: 磨耗試驗與壽命~Abrasion testing and service life
units.mechanism: 表面磨耗可能改變邊角和接觸粗糙度，試驗質量損失提供材料比較，卻不是直接的年損耗率。試驗介質、撞擊能量和時間與現地不同，必須把可重現的試驗排序與實際耐久機制分開。 假設試樣乾質量1.000kg，指定磨耗試驗後0.950kg，損失(1−0.95)/1=5%；不能直接推成每年損失5%。 耐久判讀還需要考慮鹽害與濕乾循環，機械磨耗不是唯一材料退化途徑。~Abrasion can alter corners and contact roughness. Test mass loss compares material response but is not a direct annual wear rate. Media, impact energy and duration differ from service, so reproducible laboratory ranking must remain separate from the mechanisms governing real durability. Assume dry sample1.000kg and0.950kg after a specified abrasion test. Loss is5%, which cannot be interpreted as5% annual service loss. Durability interpretation must also consider salt exposure and wet-dry cycling, because mechanical abrasion is not the sole material deterioration mechanism.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設試樣乾質量1.000kg，指定磨耗試驗後0.950kg，損失(1−0.95)/1=5%；不能直接推成每年損失5%。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry sample1.000kg and0.950kg after a specified abrasion test. Loss is5%, which cannot be interpreted as5% annual service loss.
units.verify: 核對試驗程序、含水條件與秤重時間，記錄失重之外的裂縫和缺角形態。將不同批次依同方法比較，另以現地追蹤建立環境與材料反應的關聯。確認兩次秤重使用相同乾燥基準。~Verify test procedure, moisture condition and weighing time and record cracking or corner loss beyond mass change. Compare batches under the same method, using field follow-up separately to relate environment and material response. Confirm identical drying reference conditions for both weighings.
units.failure: 試樣表面殘水會掩蓋實際失重，破碎與均勻磨耗又可能有相同總質量差；若據此直接預測剩餘年限，會忽略局部接觸臂受損對結構功能的放大作用。~Residual water hides actual mass loss, while fragmentation and uniform wear can produce equal changes. Direct lifetime extrapolation then misses how localized damage to a contact arm disproportionately affects the function of the complete unit.
units.misconception: 一次磨耗試驗失重百分比就是構件每年的耗損百分比。~Mass-loss percentage in one abrasion test equals the unit's annual loss percentage.
units.practice: 核對試驗程序、含水條件與秤重時間，記錄失重之外的裂縫和缺角形態。將不同批次依同方法比較，另以現地追蹤建立環境與材料反應的關聯。~Verify test procedure, moisture condition and weighing time and record cracking or corner loss beyond mass change. Compare batches under the same method, using field follow-up separately to relate environment and material response.

title: 消波塊製作與安放~Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement
summary: 把消波構件的材料品質、形狀與安放接觸連成可追溯驗證。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。~Connect concrete armour material quality, geometry and placed contacts through traceable verification. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
history: 本課以不同用途的混凝土海事構件對照材料與形狀的重要性，不把所有消波塊視為同一產品。美國官方目錄列二〇〇二年海岸工程手冊；新加坡在二〇一六年記錄大士港首座沉箱，提供大型混凝土製造的比較背景。荷蘭主管機關二〇二五年介紹阿夫魯戴克專用護面構件的粗糙外形與空隙，說明形狀、水理和安放接觸需要一起處理。碼頭沉箱不是消波塊，兩者只在材料生產與追溯觀念上比較。課程所有配比、質量及試驗值都是合成假設，並非專利構件的製造規格或專案驗收標準。~The course compares concrete maritime components to show why material and shape both matter, rather than treating every armour unit as one product. USACE lists its Coastal Engineering Manual in2002. Singapore records the first Tuas caisson in2016, providing a large-concrete fabrication comparison. In2025 the Dutch owner described roughness and voids in dedicated Afsluitdijk armour elements, linking shape, hydraulics and contacts. A quay caisson is not an armour block; the comparison concerns production and traceability only. Every mixture, mass and test value in the lessons is synthetic, not a proprietary manufacturing specification or project acceptance criterion.
example: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾質量3000kg、材料密度2400kg/m³，實體V=M/ρ=1.25m³；海水1025kg/m³時有效重為16.86kN，非產品規格。假設質量由3000增10%為3300kg、材料密度不變，實體體積由1.25增為1.375m³，海水中有效重量由16.86094增至18.54703kN；不是不同形狀構件可按質量互換的證明。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。~This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass3000kg and density2400kg/m³: solid V=1.25m³. In seawater1025kg/m³ effective weight is16.86kN; these are not product specifications. Increasing mass from3000 to3300kg by10% at unchanged density raises solid volume from1.25 to1.375m³ and submerged weight from16.86094 to18.54703kN. This does not justify substituting different unit shapes by mass. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾質量3000kg、材料密度2400kg/m³，實體V=M/ρ=1.25m³；海水1025kg/m³時有效重為16.86kN，非產品規格。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass3000kg and density2400kg/m³: solid V=1.25m³. In seawater1025kg/m³ effective weight is16.86kN; these are not product specifications.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設膠材340kg、加入水170kg，其中8kg被乾骨材吸收且無表面水，有效水膠比(170−8)/340=0.4765；非配方建議。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume binder340kg and water170kg, with8kg absorbed by dry aggregate and no surface water. Effective ratio=(170−8)/340=0.4765, not a mix recommendation.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設α=10⁻⁵/K、均勻溫差25K、長L=2m，自由變形ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm；不含約束。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assumeα=10⁻⁵/K, uniform change25K and length2m. Free movement ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm, excluding restraint.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設E=25GPa、α=10⁻⁵/K、完全約束冷卻25K，σ=EαΔT=6.25MPa拉應力；實際開裂與徐變需另算。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume E=25GPa,α=10⁻⁵/K and fully restrained cooling25K. Elastic tensionσ=EαΔT=6.25MPa; cracking and creep require separate treatment.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設立方試體邊長0.15m、破壞荷重900kN，f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa；不是直接設計強度。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a0.15m cube and failure load900kN. f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa is specimen strength, not directly a design strength.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設質量3000kg、兩索各與垂直45°且靜態對稱，T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN；未含動載或偏心。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass3000kg and two symmetric static slings45° from vertical. T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN, excluding dynamics and eccentricity.
